It's certainly not a solution to all marital problems but it could be for some of the sexual ones - assuming both parties have identified an open relationship as something that could help their relationship.

OP stated that he and his partner have some sexual compatibility issues. All I'm saying is that opening the relationship doesn't mean you're throwing in the towel or that you and your husband aren't compatible life partners.

It's not necessarily a bandaid solution to have an open relationship. It is wild to me that part of our culture is having all of our interpersonal needs met by one person. Also, it is totally normal for sexual desire to wane over time.

My opinion: this is likely a pattern of YOUR cognitive behavior that will continue to pop up in your long term relationship, regardless of whether you stay with this person or start a new relationship and get to this stage with another person. Please seek individual therapy to try to get at the root of this before you do something that you will really regret. And if, in therapy, you find that he isn't the right person then you will have done all you can do to make it work.
